verdict.rationale: The evidence shows rule-based built-in workflows that set fields, a priority single-select field, API and Actions building blocks, and assigning issues to Copilot to do the work. None of this documents AI that automatically triages or prioritizes incoming items. Those are adjacent features or developer primitives, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks
